candidate_windows.window_text: In this section, we dive into the details and definitions of our experimental setting. First, we present our OOD detection performance metrics (Sec. B.1), then we provide a couple samples for one of the small language shifts (Sec. B.4). We also discuss the choices of pre-trained model (Sec. B.6) and how we adapted common OOD detectors to the text generation case (Sec. B.7).

We had a budget of 20000h on NVIDIA V100 GPU. While this is an important number it was used to compute the benchmarks over many pairs and languages. In practice our OOD detectors do not require much addition computation overhead since they only rely on the probability distributions already output by the models.
